build_HydraModel: build a HydraModel with a backbone and output heads for atomic property prediction
create_BackboneInterface_subclass: create a subclass of BackboneInterface implementing forward and inference settings methods
create_HeadInterface_subclass: create a subclass of HeadInterface implementing forward to predict targets from embeddings
setup_tasks_HydraModel: setup tasks on a HydraModel instance from a checkpoint config list
add_tasks_HydraModel: add inference-only tasks like forces or stress to an existing HydraModel
